s: To eradicate corruption from the Government a new institution called Dhrma Mahamatra was started by Chief Minister N.T. Rarma Rao. Who was the first to hold the post

The post was inspired by the concept of Dharma Mahamatras appointed by Emperor Ashoka to oversee ethical governance and public welfare. N. Vittal (N. Vittal, IAS) became the first Dharma Mahamatra of Andhra Pradesh. He later served as the Chief Vigilance Commissioner of India and became widely known for his work against corruption.

Option (2).
